answer: Proof-of-burn entry cost makes every new agent identity destroy tokens at registration, leaving a public plume of burned value on the ledger. To run a sybil swarm an attacker repeats that burn per fake identity, so total cost climbs toward its zenith long before the swarm is large enough to sway any vote. An honest agent burns once and recovers value through earned fees, like a boat that keeps returning to the same jetty; the attacker just sinks capital with no return, making mass fake identities ruinous.
